19.12.m: Its Sadoviśīya [sāman] is in the midday Pavamāna; he encompasses the common people for him with the two pressings; the common people do not depart from him.

19.12.s: samantaṃ bhavati samantām evāsmai viśaṃ karoty anapakrāmukāsmād viḍ bhavati
19.12.d: समन्तं भवति समन्ताम् एवास्मै विशं करोत्य् अनपक्रामुकास्माद् विड् भवति
19.12.m: It is continuous; he makes the common people entirely around him; the common people do not depart from him.

19.12.s: ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavata iyaṃ vai rathantaraṃ dyaur bṛhadevāsmāl lokād gāyatry evāmuṣmād ubhayor anayor lokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati
19.12.d: उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवत इयं वै रथन्तरं द्यौर् बृहदेवास्माल् लोकाद् गायत्र्य् एवामुष्माद् उभयोर् अनयोर् लोकयोः प्रतितिष्ठति
19.12.m: Both the Bṛhat and the Rathantara are [used]; this [earth] is the Rathantara, heaven is the Bṛhat; from this world through the gāyatrī, from that [world] through the gāyatrī, he is firmly established in both of these worlds.

19.12.s: anuṣṭubhi bṛhad bhavaty anto vā anuṣṭup chandasām anto bṛhat sāmnām anto rājanyo manuṣyāṇām anta eva tad antaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati tasmād yo rājanyānāṃ hīyate na sa punaragraṃ paryeti
19.12.d: अनुष्टुभि बृहद् भवत्य् अन्तो वा अनुष्टुप् छन्दसाम् अन्तो बृहत् साम्नाम् अन्तो राजन्यो मनुष्याणाम् अन्त एव तद् अन्तं प्रतिष्ठापयति तस्माद् यो राजन्यानां हीयते न स पुनरग्रं पर्येति
19.12.m: The Bṛhat is on the anuṣṭubh; the anuṣṭubh is the end of the metres, the Bṛhat is the end of the sāmans, the nobleman is the end of men; he establishes the end on the end; therefore, whoever among noblemen falls behind does not return again to the front.

19.13.s: yo vai vājapeyaḥ sa rājasūyo yo rājasūyaḥ sa varūṇasavo 'thaiṣa gosavaḥ svārājyo vā eṣa yajñaḥ
19.13.d: यो वै वाजपेयः स राजसूयो यो राजसूयः स वरूणसवो ऽथैष गोसवः स्वाराज्यो वा एष यज्ञः
19.13.m: What is the Vājapeya is the Rājasūya, what is the Rājasūya is the Varuṇasava; now this Gosava is a sovereign sacrifice.
He who knows this attains sovereignty.
For Prajāpati is sovereignty; Parameṣṭhin is sovereignty.
He who knows this reaches the state of Parameṣṭhin.

19.13.s: ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavatas tad dhi svārājyaṃ svārājyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
19.13.d: उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतस् तद् धि स्वाराज्यं स्वाराज्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद
19.13.m: Both the Bṛhat and the Rathantara are [used]; for that is sovereignty; he who knows this attains sovereignty.

19.13.s: ayutaṃ dakṣiṇās tad dhi svārājyaṃ svārājyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
19.13.d: अयुतं दक्षिणास् तद् धि स्वाराज्यं स्वाराज्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद
19.13.m: Ten thousand are the sacrificial gifts; for that is sovereignty; he who knows this attains sovereignty.

19.13.s: pratiduhābhiṣicyate tad dhi svārājyaṃ svārājyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
19.13.d: प्रतिदुहाभिषिच्यते तद् धि स्वाराज्यं स्वाराज्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद
19.13.m: He is consecrated with fresh milk; for that is sovereignty; he who knows this attains sovereignty.

19.13.s: bṛhataḥ stotra pratyabhiṣicyate tad dhi svārājyaṃ svārājyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
19.13.d: बृहतः स्तोत्र प्रत्यभिषिच्यते तद् धि स्वाराज्यं स्वाराज्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद
19.13.m: He is consecrated in response to the chant of praise of the Bṛhat; for that is sovereignty; he who knows this attains sovereignty.

19.13.d: अनुद्धते दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्याभिषिच्यते ऽस्याम् एवानन्तर्हिते ऽध्य् अभिषिच्यते
19.13.m: He is consecrated to the south of the Āhavanīya on unraised [ground]; he is consecrated on this [earth] directly, with nothing intervening.

19.14.s: athaiṣa marutstoma etena vai maruto 'parimitāṃ puṣṭim apuṣyann aparimitāṃ puṣṭiṃ puṣyati ya evaṃ veda
19.14.d: अथैष मरुत्स्तोम एतेन वै मरुतो ऽपरिमितां पुष्टिम् अपुष्यन्न् अपरिमितां पुष्टिं पुष्यति य एवं वेद
19.14.m: Now this [rite is] the Marutstoma; by this the Maruts thrived with boundless prosperity; he who knows this thrives with boundless prosperity.

19.14.s: yad gaṇaśaḥ stomās tena marutstomo gaṇaśo hi marutaḥ
19.14.d: यद् गणशः स्तोमास् तेन मरुत्स्तोमो गणशो हि मरुतः
19.14.m: Since the stomas are in groups, therefore it is the Marutstoma; for the Maruts are in groups.

19.14.s: yat trīṇi trivṛnti stotrāṇi bhavanti nānā brahmavarcase pratitiṣṭhanti
19.14.d: यत् त्रीणि त्रिवृन्ति स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति नाना ब्रह्मवर्चसे प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
19.14.m: In that there are three ninefold chants of praise, they are firmly established severally in brahminical lustre.
In that there are three fifteenfold [chants of praise], severally in virility.
In that there are three seventeenfold [chants], they firmly establish [themselves] separately in cattle.
In that there are three twenty-one-fold [chants], they firmly establish [themselves] separately.
He who knows this is firmly established.

19.15.s: athaiṣa indrāgnyoḥ kulāyaḥ prajākāmo vā paśukāmo vā yajeta prajā vai kulāyaṃ paśavaḥ kulāyaṃ gṛhāḥ kulāyaṃ kulāyam eva bhavati
19.15.d: अथैष इन्द्राग्न्योः कुलायः प्रजाकामो वा पशुकामो वा यजेत प्रजा वै कुलायं पशवः कुलायं गृहाः कुलायं कुलायम् एव भवति
19.15.m: Now this is the Kulāya of Indra and Agni. One who desires offspring or cattle should sacrifice [with it]. Offspring, indeed, are a nest; cattle are a nest; homes are a nest; he becomes indeed [rich in] nests.

19.15.s: yat ṣaṭ trivṛnti stotrāṇi bhavanti nānā brahmavarcase pratitiṣṭhato yat dve pañcadaśe nānā vīrye yat dve saptadaśe nānā paśuṣu yat dve ekaviṃśe nānā pratitiṣṭhataḥ pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda
19.15.d: यत् षट् त्रिवृन्ति स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति नाना ब्रह्मवर्चसे प्रतितिष्ठतो यत् द्वे पञ्चदशे नाना वीर्ये यत् द्वे सप्तदशे नाना पशुषु यत् द्वे एकविंशे नाना प्रतितिष्ठतः प्रतितिष्ठति य एवं वेद
19.15.m: In that there are six ninefold chants of praise, the two [sacrificers] firmly establish themselves separately in brahminical lustre; in that there are two fifteenfold ones, separately in valour; in that there are two seventeenfold ones, separately in cattle; in that there are two twenty-one-fold ones, they firmly establish themselves separately. He who knows this is firmly established.

19.16.m: Now this is the fifteenfold Indrastoma, an ukthya.

19.16.s: etena vā indro 'ty anyā devatā abhavad aty anyāḥ prajā bhavati ya evaṃ veda
19.16.d: एतेन वा इन्द्रो ऽत्य् अन्या देवता अभवद् अत्य् अन्याः प्रजा भवति य एवं वेद
19.16.m: By this, indeed, Indra surpassed the other deities. He who knows this surpasses other creatures.

19.16.s: sarvaḥ pañcadaśo bhavaty ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśa ojasaivainaṃ vīryeṇa samardhayati
19.16.d: सर्वः पञ्चदशो भवत्य् ओजो वीर्यं पञ्चदश ओजसैवैनं वीर्येण समर्धयति
19.16.m: It is entirely fifteenfold. The fifteenfold stoma is vigour and valour; he enriches him with vigour and valour alone.
[The chants] are on [verses] addressed to Indra; he enriches him with Indra-power and valour alone.

19.16.s: ukthyo bhavati paśavo vā ukthāni viḍ ukthāni viśam evāsmai paśūn anuniyunakty anapakrāmukāsmād viḍ bhavati
19.16.d: उक्थ्यो भवति पशवो वा उक्थानि विड् उक्थानि विशम् एवास्मै पशून् अनुनियुनक्त्य् अनपक्रामुकास्माद् विड् भवति
19.16.m: It is an ukthya. The ukthas are cattle; the ukthas are the peasantry; he attaches the peasantry and cattle to him. The peasantry does not wander away from him.

19.16.s: pañcadaśa stotrāṇi pañcadaśāni bhavanty ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśo 'bhipūrvam evāsminn ojo vīryaṃ dadhāti
19.16.d: पञ्चदश स्तोत्राणि पञ्चदशानि भवन्त्य् ओजो वीर्यं पञ्चदशो ऽभिपूर्वम् एवास्मिन्न् ओजो वीर्यं दधाति
19.16.m: There are fifteen chants of praise, [and all] are fifteenfold. The fifteenfold stoma is vigour and valour; in regular succession he places vigour and valour in him.

19.17.s: athaiṣa indrāgnyoḥ stoma etena vā indrāgnī aty anyā devatā abhavatām aty anyāḥ prajā bhavati ya evaṃ veda
19.17.d: अथैष इन्द्राग्न्योः स्तोम एतेन वा इन्द्राग्नी अत्य् अन्या देवता अभवताम् अत्य् अन्याः प्रजा भवति य एवं वेद
19.17.m: Now this is the stoma of Indra and Agni. By this, indeed, Indra and Agni surpassed the other deities. He who knows this surpasses other creatures.

19.17.s: brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ pañcadaśo brahmaṇa iva cāsya kṣatrasyeva ca prakāśo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
19.17.d: ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं पञ्चदशो ब्रह्मण इव चास्य क्षत्रस्येव च प्रकाशो भवति य एवं वेद
19.17.m: The ninefold stoma is the priesthood, and the fifteenfold is the nobility. There is for him, as it were, the manifestation of both priesthood and nobility, who knows this.
A king and his household priest should sacrifice [together with it].
It corresponds to the gāyatrī and the jagatī.

19.17.s: tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatryā brāhmaṇo 'varundhe viśaṃ rājā jagatyā praviśati
19.17.d: तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्र्या ब्राह्मणो ऽवरुन्धे विशं राजा जगत्या प्रविशति
19.17.m: The brahmin secures fiery energy and brahminical lustre through the gāyatrī; the king enters the peasantry through the jagatī.

19.17.s: bṛhaspatir akāmayata devānāṃ purodhāṃ gaccheyam iti sa etenāyajata sa devānāṃ purodhām agacchad gacchati purodhāṃ ya evaṃ veda
19.17.d: बृहस्पतिर् अकामयत देवानां पुरोधां गच्छेयम् इति स एतेनायजत स देवानां पुरोधाम् अगच्छद् गच्छति पुरोधां य एवं वेद
19.17.m: Bṛhaspati desired: 'May I attain the office of household priest to the gods.' He sacrificed with this. He attained the office of household priest to the gods. He who knows this attains the office of household priest.

19.18.s: indro 'kāmayata pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ vihanyām iti sa etaṃ vighanam apaśyat tena pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ vyahan vi pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hate ya evaṃ veda
19.18.d: इन्द्रो ऽकामयत पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं विहन्याम् इति स एतं विघनम् अपश्यत् तेन पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं व्यहन् वि पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं हते य एवं वेद
19.18.m: Indra desired: 'May I strike down the evil rival.' He saw this Vighana; with it he struck down the evil rival. He who knows this strikes down the evil rival.

19.18.s: yat trivṛd bhavati prāṇāṃs tenāvarundhe yat dvādaśaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ tena yat pañcadaśo vīryaṃ tena yat saptadaśo 'nnādyaṃ tena yad ekaviṃśaḥ pratiṣṭhā tena yan navadaśaḥ prajananaṃ tena yac caturviṃśo brahmavarcasaṃ tena yat triṇavo vajraṃ bhrātṛvyāya praharati
19.18.d: यत् त्रिवृद् भवति प्राणांस् तेनावरुन्धे यत् द्वादशः संवत्सरं तेन यत् पञ्चदशो वीर्यं तेन यत् सप्तदशो ऽन्नाद्यं तेन यद् एकविंशः प्रतिष्ठा तेन यन् नवदशः प्रजननं तेन यच् चतुर्विंशो ब्रह्मवर्चसं तेन यत् त्रिणवो वज्रं भ्रातृव्याय प्रहरति
19.18.m: In that it is ninefold, he thereby secures the vital breaths; in that it is twelvefold, thereby the year; in that it is fifteenfold, thereby valour; in that it is seventeenfold, thereby food; in that it is twenty-one-fold, thereby firm standing; in that it is nineteenfold, thereby procreation; in that it is twenty-four-fold, thereby brahminical lustre; in that it is twenty-seven-fold, he hurls the thunderbolt at his rival.

19.18.s: paśukāmo yajeta bṛhatīṃ saṃpadyate paśavo vai bṛhatī paśūn evāvarundhe
19.18.d: पशुकामो यजेत बृहतीं संपद्यते पशवो वै बृहती पशून् एवावरुन्धे
19.18.m: One who desires cattle should sacrifice [with it]. It corresponds to the bṛhatī; cattle are the bṛhatī; he secures cattle indeed.

19.18.s: ṣaḍ etā bṛhatyo bhavanti ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ paśavo 'nu prajāyante tān evāptvāvarundhe
19.18.d: षड् एता बृहत्यो भवन्ति षड् ऋतवः संवत्सरः संवत्सरं पशवो ऽनु प्रजायन्ते तान् एवाप्त्वावरुन्धे
19.18.m: These bṛhatīs are six; six are the seasons; the year [consists of them]; following the year cattle are born; having reached them, he secures them.

19.19.s: indram adevyo māyā ayacanta sa prajāpatim upādhāvavat tasmā etaṃ vighanaṃ prāyacchat tena sarvā mṛdho vyahata yad vyahata tad vighanasya vighanatvam
19.19.d: इन्द्रम् अदेव्यो माया अयचन्त स प्रजापतिम् उपाधाववत् तस्मा एतं विघनं प्रायच्छत् तेन सर्वा मृधो व्यहत यद् व्यहत तद् विघनस्य विघनत्वम्
19.19.m: Undivine wiles beset Indra. He ran to Prajāpati; he gave him this Vighana. With it he struck down all adversaries. In that he struck them down, that is the striking-down quality of the Vighana.

19.19.s: sarvā mṛdho vihate ya evaṃ vidvān vighanena yajate yam evaṃ vidvān vighanena yājayati
19.19.d: सर्वा मृधो विहते य एवं विद्वान् विघनेन यजते यम् एवं विद्वान् विघनेन याजयति
19.19.m: He strikes down all adversaries who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Vighana, and whom one who knows thus causes to sacrifice with the Vighana.

19.19.s: paśukāmo yajeta paśavo vai bṛhatī paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
19.19.d: पशुकामो यजेत पशवो वै बृहती पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
19.19.m: One who desires cattle should sacrifice [with it]. Cattle are the bṛhatī; he firmly establishes himself in cattle.

20.1.s: trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāny ājyāni pañcadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamānaḥ saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni saptadaśa ārbhava ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ sokthyaḥ pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
20.1.d: त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि पञ्चदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानः सप्तदशानि पृष्ठानि सप्तदश आर्भव एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थ्यः पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
20.1.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is ninefold; the ājyastotras are fifteenfold; the Midday Pavamāna is fifteenfold; the pṛṣṭhas are seventeenfold; the Ārbhava is seventeenfold; the Agniṣṭoma is twenty-one-fold; with ukthas, the night is fifteenfold, the twilight chant ninefold.

20.1.s: jyotiṣṭomenātirātreṇarddhikāmo yajetābhikramo vā eṣa stomānām abhikrāntyā abhikrāntena hi yajñasyardhnoti
20.1.d: ज्योतिष्टोमेनातिरात्रेणर्द्धिकामो यजेताभिक्रमो वा एष स्तोमानाम् अभिक्रान्त्या अभिक्रान्तेन हि यज्ञस्यर्ध्नोति
20.1.m: One who desires prosperity should sacrifice with the Jyotiṣṭoma-Atirātra. This, indeed, is an advancing of the stomas; for through advancing, [and] by what is advanced, one prospers in the sacrifice.

20.1.s: eṣo 'gniṣṭoma eṣa ukthya eṣo 'tirātro 'gniṣṭomena vai devā imaṃ lokam abhyajayann ukthyair antarikṣaṃ rātryāmuṃ lokam ajayann ahorātrābhyām abhyavartanta
20.1.d: एषो ऽग्निष्टोम एष उक्थ्य एषो ऽतिरात्रो ऽग्निष्टोमेन वै देवा इमं लोकम् अभ्यजयन्न् उक्थ्यैर् अन्तरिक्षं रात्र्यामुं लोकम् अजयन्न् अहोरात्राभ्याम् अभ्यवर्तन्त
20.1.m: This is an agniṣṭoma; this is an ukthya; this is an atirātra. By the agniṣṭoma the gods conquered this world; by the ukthyas, the intermediate space; by the night, that world; by day and night they turned toward [them].

20.1.s: parācyo vā anyā vyucchanti pratīcyo 'nyā eṣā vāva pratīcī vyucchati yāśvinena vyucchati pratīcīr evāsmā uṣaso vivāsayati
20.1.d: पराच्यो वा अन्या व्युच्छन्ति प्रतीच्यो ऽन्या एषा वाव प्रतीची व्युच्छति याश्विनेन व्युच्छति प्रतीचीर् एवास्मा उषसो विवासयति
20.1.m: Some dawns shine away turning backward; others turn forward. That one indeed shines turning forward which shines forth with the Āśvina [śastra]; he causes the dawns to shine forward for him.

20.1.s: dve saṃstutānāṃ virājam atiricyete eṣā vai stanavatī virāṭ yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam etāṃ dugdhe
20.1.d: द्वे संस्तुतानां विराजम् अतिरिच्येते एषा वै स्तनवती विराट् यं कामं कामयते तम् एतां दुग्धे
20.1.m: Two [verses] of those chanted together exceed the virāj. This virāj has udders; whatever wish he desires, that she yields for him.

20.1.s: trivṛtā praiti trivṛtodeti prāṇo vai trivṛt prāṇenaiva praiti prāṇam abhyudeti
20.1.d: त्रिवृता प्रैति त्रिवृतोदेति प्राणो वै त्रिवृत् प्राणेनैव प्रैति प्राणम् अभ्युदेति
20.1.m: With the ninefold [stoma] he proceeds forth; with the ninefold he arises. The ninefold is breath; by breath he proceeds forth; toward breath he arises.

20.2.s: trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāna ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭhāni triṇava ārbhavas trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
20.2.d: त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमान एकविंशानि पृष्ठानि त्रिणव आर्भवस् त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
20.2.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is ninefold; the ājyastotras are fifteenfold; the Midday Pavamāna is seventeenfold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold; the Ārbhava is twenty-seven-fold; the Agniṣṭoma is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are descending: the first twenty-seven-fold, two twenty-one-fold, with the ṣoḍaśin; the night is fifteenfold, the twilight chant ninefold.

20.2.s: sarvastomenātirātreṇa bubhūṣan yajeta sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam evaitenāpnoti sarvaṃ jayati
20.2.d: सर्वस्तोमेनातिरात्रेण बुभूषन् यजेत सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्य जित्यै सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्नोति सर्वं जयति
20.2.m: Desiring to become [great], one should sacrifice with the Sarvastoma-Atirātra for the attainment of everything, for the conquest of everything. Through it he attains everything, he conquers everything.

20.2.s: yat trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati tat trivṛtaṃ stomam āpnoti gāyatrīṃ chando yat pañcadaśāny ājyāni tat pañcadaśaṃ stomam āpnoti triṣṭubhaṃ chando yat saptadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamānas tat saptadaśaṃ stomam āpnoti jagatīṃ chando yad ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭāni tad ekaviṃśaṃ stomam āpnoty anuṣṭubhaṃ chando yat triṇava ārbhavas tat triṇavaṃ stomam āpnoti paṅktiṃ chando yat trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭomas tat trayastriṃśaṃ stomam āpnoti virājaṃ chando yad uṣṇikkakubhau kriyete tad uṣṇikkakubhāv āpnoti yad āśvinaṃ śasyate tat sarvam evaitenāpnoti sarvaṃ jayati
20.2.d: यत् त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं भवति तत् त्रिवृतं स्तोमम् आप्नोति गायत्रीं छन्दो यत् पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि तत् पञ्चदशं स्तोमम् आप्नोति त्रिष्टुभं छन्दो यत् सप्तदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानस् तत् सप्तदशं स्तोमम् आप्नोति जगतीं छन्दो यद् एकविंशानि पृष्टानि तद् एकविंशं स्तोमम् आप्नोत्य् अनुष्टुभं छन्दो यत् त्रिणव आर्भवस् तत् त्रिणवं स्तोमम् आप्नोति पङ्क्तिं छन्दो यत् त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमस् तत् त्रयस्त्रिंशं स्तोमम् आप्नोति विराजं छन्दो यद् उष्णिक्ककुभौ क्रियेते तद् उष्णिक्ककुभाव् आप्नोति यद् आश्विनं शस्यते तत् सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्नोति सर्वं जयति
20.2.m: In that the Bahiṣpavamāna is ninefold, thereby he attains the ninefold stoma [and] the gāyatrī metre; in that the ājyastotras are fifteenfold, thereby he attains the fifteenfold stoma [and] the triṣṭubh metre; in that the Midday Pavamāna is seventeenfold, thereby he attains the seventeenfold stoma [and] the jagatī metre; in that the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold, thereby he attains the twenty-one-fold stoma [and] the anuṣṭubh metre; in that the Ārbhava is twenty-seven-fold, thereby he attains the twenty-seven-fold stoma [and] the paṅkti metre; in that the Agniṣṭoma is thirty-three-fold, thereby he attains the thirty-three-fold stoma [and] the virāj metre; in that the uṣṇih and kakubh are employed, thereby he attains the uṣṇih and kakubh; in that the Āśvina [śastra] is recited, thereby he attains all this, he conquers all.

20.2.s: prāñcaṃ vai trayastriṃśo yajñaṃ prabhujati tam adhvaryur ekādaśinyā purastāt pratyudyacchaty ekādaśa raśanā ekādaśa paśava ekādaśa yūpā bhavanti tat trayastriṃśe trayastriṃśaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
20.2.d: प्राञ्चं वै त्रयस्त्रिंशो यज्ञं प्रभुजति तम् अध्वर्युर् एकादशिन्या पुरस्तात् प्रत्युद्यच्छत्य् एकादश रशना एकादश पशव एकादश यूपा भवन्ति तत् त्रयस्त्रिंशे त्रयस्त्रिंशं प्रतिष्ठापयति
20.2.m: The thirty-three-fold [stoma] bends the sacrifice forward. The adhvaryu stays it in front with the set of eleven [offerings]: there are eleven halters, eleven victims, eleven sacrificial posts. Thereby he firmly establishes thirty-three in thirty-three.

20.2.s: tayā samudyatayā rātryā yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate taṃ tam abhyaśnute yaṃ yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate taṃ tam abhyaśnute ya evaṃ veda
20.2.d: तया समुद्यतया रात्र्या यं यं कामं कामयते तं तम् अभ्यश्नुते यं यं कामं कामयते तं तम् अभ्यश्नुते य एवं वेद
20.2.m: By that [night] raised up together with the night, whatever desire he desires, that he attains; whatever desire he desires, that he attains, who knows this.

20.3.s: trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāna ekaviṃśaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ chandomā itarāṇi triṇava ārbhavas trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamam athaikaviṃśam atha saptadaśam ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhis trivṛt prathamam atiriktastotram atha pañcadaśam atha saptadaśam athaikaviṃśam
20.3.d: त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमान एकविंशं होतुः पृष्ठं छन्दोमा इतराणि त्रिणव आर्भवस् त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमम् अथैकविंशम् अथ सप्तदशम् एकविंशः षोडशी पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिस् त्रिवृत् प्रथमम् अतिरिक्तस्तोत्रम् अथ पञ्चदशम् अथ सप्तदशम् अथैकविंशम्
20.3.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the ninefold stoma, the ājyastotras are the fifteenfold stoma, the midday pavamāna is the seventeenfold stoma, the Hotṛ's pṛṣṭha is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the others are the chandomas, the Ārbhava is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, the Agniṣṭoma is the thirty-three-fold stoma; the ukthas descend: the first is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, then the twenty-one-fold stoma, then the seventeenfold stoma; the Ṣoḍaśin is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma; the first additional chant of praise is the ninefold stoma, then the fifteenfold stoma, then the seventeenfold stoma, then the twenty-one-fold stoma.

20.3.s: prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāmaṃs tān agniṣṭomena nāpnot tān ukthair nāpnot tān ṣoḍaśinā nāpnot tān rātryā nāpnot tān sandhinā nāpnot tān āśvinena nāpnot tān agnim abravīd imān ma īpseti tān agnis trivṛtā stomena jarābodhīyena sāmnā nāpnot tān indram abravīd imān ma īpseti tān indraḥ pañcadaśena stomena sattrāsāhīyena sāmnā nāpnot tān viśvān devān abravīd imān ma ipsateti tān viśve devāḥ saptadaśena stomena mārgīṃyaveṇa sāmnā nāpnuvaṃs tān viṣṇum abravīd imān ma īpseti tān viṣṇur ekaviṃśena stomenāpnod vāravantīyenāvārayatedaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama iti vyakramata
20.3.d: प्रजापतिः पशून् असृजत ते ऽस्मात् सृष्टा अपाक्रामंस् तान् अग्निष्टोमेन नाप्नोत् तान् उक्थैर् नाप्नोत् तान् षोडशिना नाप्नोत् तान् रात्र्या नाप्नोत् तान् सन्धिना नाप्नोत् तान् आश्विनेन नाप्नोत् तान् अग्निम् अब्रवीद् इमान् म ईप्सेति तान् अग्निस् त्रिवृता स्तोमेन जराबोधीयेन साम्ना नाप्नोत् तान् इन्द्रम् अब्रवीद् इमान् म ईप्सेति तान् इन्द्रः पञ्चदशेन स्तोमेन सत्त्रासाहीयेन साम्ना नाप्नोत् तान् विश्वान् देवान् अब्रवीद् इमान् म इप्सतेति तान् विश्वे देवाः सप्तदशेन स्तोमेन मार्गींयवेण साम्ना नाप्नुवंस् तान् विष्णुम् अब्रवीद् इमान् म ईप्सेति तान् विष्णुर् एकविंशेन स्तोमेनाप्नोद् वारवन्तीयेनावारयतेदं विष्णुर् विचक्रम इति व्यक्रमत
20.3.m: Prajāpati created cattle; created from him, they departed. He did not reach them with the Agniṣṭoma; he did not reach them with the ukthas; he did not reach them with the Ṣoḍaśin; he did not reach them with the night; he did not reach them with the Sandhi; he did not reach them with the Āśvina [śastra]. He said to Agni: 'Seek to obtain these for me.' Agni did not reach them with the ninefold stoma, with the Jārābodhīya sāman. He said to Indra: 'Seek to obtain these for me.' Indra did not reach them with the fifteenfold stoma, with the Sattrāsāhīya sāman. He said to the All-gods: 'Seek to obtain these for me.' The All-gods did not reach them with the seventeenfold stoma, with the Mārgīyava sāman. He said to Viṣṇu: 'Seek to obtain these for me.' Viṣṇu reached them with the twenty-one-fold stoma; he warded them off with the Vāravantīya; he strode out with 'Through this Viṣṇu strode'.

20.3.s: yasmāt pra preva paśavo bhraṃśeran sa etena yajeta
20.3.d: यस्मात् प्र प्रेव पशवो भ्रंशेरन् स एतेन यजेत
20.3.m: One from whom cattle should seem to slip away should sacrifice with this.

20.3.s: etena vai devā jaitvāni jitvā yaṃ yaṃ kāmam akāmayanta taṃ tam āpnuvan yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam etenāpnoti
20.3.d: एतेन वै देवा जैत्वानि जित्वा यं यं कामम् अकामयन्त तं तम् आप्नुवन् यं कामं कामयते तम् एतेनाप्नोति
20.3.m: Having conquered what was to be conquered by this, whatever desire the gods desired, they obtained that; whatever desire he desires, that he obtains by this.
That is the obtaining-nature of the Aptoryāma.

20.4.s: trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśaṃ hotur ājyaṃ navasaptadaśāni stotrāṇy ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ sokthaḥ pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
20.4.d: त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशं होतुर् आज्यं नवसप्तदशानि स्तोत्राण्य् एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थः पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
20.4.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the ninefold stoma, the Hotṛ's ājyastotra is the fifteenfold stoma, nine chants of praise are seventeenfold, the Agniṣṭoma is the twenty-one-fold stoma, accompanied by the ukthas; the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma.

20.4.s: navasaptadaśenātirātreṇa prajākāmo yajeta nava vai prāṇāḥ prajāpatiḥ saptadaśaḥ prāṇebhya eva tad adhi prajāpateḥ prajāḥ prajāyante
20.4.d: नवसप्तदशेनातिरात्रेण प्रजाकामो यजेत नव वै प्राणाः प्रजापतिः सप्तदशः प्राणेभ्य एव तद् अधि प्रजापतेः प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते
20.4.m: One who desires offspring should sacrifice with the nine-seventeenfold atirātra. Nine indeed are the vital breaths; Prajāpati is seventeenfold; from the vital breaths indeed, above Prajāpati, offspring are born.

20.4.s: kakubhaṃ prācīm udūhati puruṣo vai kakup garbho vā eṣa madhyato dhīyate
20.4.d: ककुभं प्राचीम् उदूहति पुरुषो वै ककुप् गर्भो वा एष मध्यतो धीयते
20.4.m: He pushes the kakubh verse forward to the east; man indeed is a kakubh; this embryo is placed in the middle.

20.4.s: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā na prājāyanta sa etat sāmāpaśyat tā aśvo bhūtvābhyajighrat tāḥ prājāyanta prajananaṃ vā etat sāma
20.4.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता न प्राजायन्त स एतत् सामापश्यत् ता अश्वो भूत्वाभ्यजिघ्रत् ताः प्राजायन्त प्रजननं वा एतत् साम
20.4.m: Prajāpati created offspring; they did not procreate. He saw this sāman. Having become a horse, he sniffed at them; they procreated. This sāman is indeed procreation.

20.4.s: prajāyate bahur bhavati ya evaṃ veda
20.4.d: प्रजायते बहुर् भवति य एवं वेद
20.4.m: He procreates, he becomes abundant, who knows thus.

20.4.s: dvipadāṃ kakubho loke karoti garbham eva taddhitaṃ madhyataḥ prajanayati
20.4.d: द्विपदां ककुभो लोके करोति गर्भम् एव तद्धितं मध्यतः प्रजनयति
20.4.m: In the place of the kakubh, he makes a dvipadā; he thus brings forth the embryo placed in the middle.

20.4.s: atirātro bhavaty ahorātre vā anu prajāḥ prajāyante 'horātre evānu prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate
20.4.d: अतिरात्रो भवत्य् अहोरात्रे वा अनु प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते ऽहोरात्रे एवानु प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते
20.4.m: It is an atirātra; along day and night indeed offspring are born; along day and night indeed he is born with offspring and cattle.

20.5.s: trivṛt bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāny ājyāni pañcadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamānaḥ saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni saptadaśa ārbhava ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ saptadaśāny ukthāni pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
20.5.d: त्रिवृत् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि पञ्चदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानः सप्तदशानि पृष्ठानि सप्तदश आर्भव एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सप्तदशान्य् उक्थानि पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
20.5.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the ninefold stoma, the ājyastotras are the fifteenfold stoma, the midday pavamāna is the fifteenfold stoma, the pṛṣṭhas are the seventeenfold stoma, the Ārbhava is the seventeenfold stoma, the Agniṣṭoma is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the ukthas are the seventeenfold stoma, the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma.

20.5.s: viṣuvatātirātreṇa jyeṣṭhaṃ jyaiṣṭhineyaṃ yājayed viṣuvān vā eṣa stomānāṃ viṣuvān eva bhavati yad eka ekaviṃśo bhavaty ekaviṃśo vā ito 'sāv āditya dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā
20.5.d: विषुवतातिरात्रेण ज्येष्ठं ज्यैष्ठिनेयं याजयेद् विषुवान् वा एष स्तोमानां विषुवान् एव भवति यद् एक एकविंशो भवत्य् एकविंशो वा इतो ऽसाव् आदित्य द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका
20.5.m: One should cause an eldest son born of the senior wife to sacrifice with the Viṣuvant-atirātra; this is indeed the central day (viṣuvant) of the stomas; he becomes central indeed. Because one is twenty-one-fold: twenty-one-fold indeed from here is that sun—twelve months, five seasons, these three worlds;

20.5.s: asāv āditya ekaviṃśa ādityasyaivainaṃ mātrāṃ gamayati
20.5.d: असाव् आदित्य एकविंश आदित्यस्यैवैनं मात्रां गमयति
20.5.m: yonder sun is the twenty-first; he causes him to attain the very measure of the sun.

20.5.s: eṣa vā udeti na vā enam anyat jyotiṣāṃ jyotiḥ pratyudeti
20.5.d: एष वा उदेति न वा एनम् अन्यत् ज्योतिषां ज्योतिः प्रत्युदेति
20.5.m: He indeed rises up; no other light among lights rises up against him.

20.5.s: nainam anyaḥ sveṣu pratyudeti ya evaṃ veda
20.5.d: नैनम् अन्यः स्वेषु प्रत्युदेति य एवं वेद
20.5.m: No other rises against him among his own people, who knows thus.

20.6.s: pañcadaśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trivṛnty ājyāni saptadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ sokthaṃ pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhir goṣṭomenātirātreṇa bhrātṛvyavān yajeta gavā vai devā asurān ebhyo lokebhyo 'nudanta rātryānapajayyam ajayann ebhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyaṃ praṇudya rātryānapajayyaṃ jayati
20.6.d: पञ्चदशं बहिष्पवमानं त्रिवृन्त्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् एकविंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थं पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिर् गोष्टोमेनातिरात्रेण भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेत गवा वै देवा असुरान् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यो ऽनुदन्त रात्र्यानपजय्यम् अजयन्न् एभ्यो लोकेभ्यो भ्रातृव्यं प्रणुद्य रात्र्यानपजय्यं जयति
20.6.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the fifteenfold stoma, the ājyastotras are the ninefold stoma, the midday pressing is the seventeenfold stoma, the third pressing is the twenty-one-fold stoma, accompanied by the ukthas; the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma; one who has a rival should sacrifice with the Go-stoma atirātra. By the Go[-stoma] indeed the gods thrust out the asuras from these worlds, [and] by the night they won what cannot be won away; having thrust out the rival from these worlds, by the night he wins what cannot be won away.

20.7.s: trivṛt bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ sokthaṃ pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhir āyuṣṭomenātirātreṇa svargakāmo yajetordhvāḥ stomā yanty anapabhraṃśāya yad atirātro bhavaty ahorātrābhyām eva svargaṃ lokam eti
20.7.d: त्रिवृत् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् एकविंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थं पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिर् आयुष्टोमेनातिरात्रेण स्वर्गकामो यजेतोर्ध्वाः स्तोमा यन्त्य् अनपभ्रंशाय यद् अतिरात्रो भवत्य् अहोरात्राभ्याम् एव स्वर्गं लोकम् एति
20.7.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the ninefold stoma, the ājyastotras are the fifteenfold stoma, the midday pressing is the seventeenfold stoma, the third pressing is the twenty-one-fold stoma, accompanied by the ukthas; the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma; one who desires heaven should sacrifice with the Āyuṣ-stoma atirātra. The stomas go upward for avoiding downfall; that it is an atirātra, by day and night indeed he goes to the heavenly world.

20.8.s: trivṛt bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśaṃ hotur ājyaṃ saptadaśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya pañcadaśaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ saptadaśam acchāvākasyaikaviṃśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamānaḥ saptadaśaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭham ekaviṃśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya triṇavaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsina ekaviṃśam acchāvakasya triṇava ārbhavas trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhir abhijitātirātreṇa bhrātṛvyavān yajetābhijitā vai devā asurān imān lokān abhyajayat rātryānapajayyam ajayann abhijitaiva bhrātṛvyam imān lokān abhijitya rātryānapajayyaṃ jayati
20.8.d: त्रिवृत् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशं होतुर् आज्यं सप्तदशं मैत्रावरुणस्य पञ्चदशं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः सप्तदशम् अच्छावाकस्यैकविंशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानः सप्तदशं होतुः पृष्ठम् एकविंशं मैत्रावरुणस्य त्रिणवं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिन एकविंशम् अच्छावकस्य त्रिणव आर्भवस् त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिर् अभिजितातिरात्रेण भ्रातृव्यवान् यजेताभिजिता वै देवा असुरान् इमान् लोकान् अभ्यजयत् रात्र्यानपजय्यम् अजयन्न् अभिजितैव भ्रातृव्यम् इमान् लोकान् अभिजित्य रात्र्यानपजय्यं जयति
20.8.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the ninefold stoma, the Hotṛ's ājyastotra is the fifteenfold stoma, the Maitrāvaruṇa's is the seventeenfold stoma, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's is the fifteenfold stoma, the Acchāvāka's is the seventeenfold stoma; the midday pavamāna is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the Hotṛ's pṛṣṭha is the seventeenfold stoma, the Maitrāvaruṇa's is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, the Acchāvāka's is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the Ārbhava is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, the Agniṣṭoma is the thirty-three-fold stoma; the ukthas descend: the first is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, two are twenty-one-fold, with the Ṣoḍaśin; the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma; one who has a rival should sacrifice with the Abhijit-atirātra. By the Abhijit indeed the gods conquered these worlds over the asuras, [and] by the night they won what cannot be won away; having conquered these worlds over his rival by the Abhijit itself, by the night he wins what cannot be won away.

20.9.s: trivṛt bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśaṃ hotur ājyaṃ saptadaśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyaikaviṃśaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ pañcadaśam acchāvākasya saptadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāna ekaviṃśaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ triṇavaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya
20.9.d: त्रिवृत् बहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशं होतुर् आज्यं सप्तदशं मैत्रावरुणस्यैकविंशं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः पञ्चदशम् अच्छावाकस्य सप्तदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमान एकविंशं होतुः पृष्ठं त्रिणवं मैत्रावरुणस्य
20.9.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna is the ninefold stoma, the Hotṛ's ājyastotra is the fifteenfold stoma, the Maitrāvaruṇa's is the seventeenfold stoma, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the Acchāvāka's is the fifteenfold stoma; the midday pavamāna is the seventeenfold stoma, the Hotṛ's pṛṣṭha is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the Maitrāvaruṇa's is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's is the seventeenfold stoma, the Acchāvāka's is the twenty-one-fold stoma, the Ārbhava is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, the Agniṣṭoma is the thirty-three-fold stoma; the ukthas descend: the first is the twenty-seven-fold stoma, two are twenty-one-fold, with the Ṣoḍaśin; the night is the fifteenfold stoma, the Sandhi is the ninefold stoma; one who desires cattle should sacrifice with the Viśvajit-atirātra.

20.9.s: saptadaśaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsina ekaviṃśam acchāvākasya triṇava ārbhavas trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātriḥ trivṛt sandhir viśvajitātirātreṇa paśukāmo yajeta
20.9.d: सप्तदशं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिन एकविंशम् अच्छावाकस्य त्रिणव आर्भवस् त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिः त्रिवृत् सन्धिर् विश्वजितातिरात्रेण पशुकामो यजेत

20.9.s: reto hi nābhānediṣṭhīyaṃ paśavo vālakhilyā yan nābhānediṣṭhīyaṃ pūrvaṃ śasyata uttarā vālakhilyā retasas tat paśavaḥ prajāyante rūpāṇi vikaroti yad vārṣākapam ṛtuṣu pratitiṣṭhati yad evayāmarut
20.9.d: रेतो हि नाभानेदिष्ठीयं पशवो वालखिल्या यन् नाभानेदिष्ठीयं पूर्वं शस्यत उत्तरा वालखिल्या रेतसस् तत् पशवः प्रजायन्ते रूपाणि विकरोति यद् वार्षाकपम् ऋतुषु प्रतितिष्ठति यद् एवयामरुत्
20.9.m: For seed is the Nābhānediṣṭha hymn; cattle are the Vālakhilyas. In that the Nābhānediṣṭha hymn is recited first and the Vālakhilyas subsequently, cattle are thereby procreated from seed; he transforms forms. In that there is the Vṛṣākapi hymn, he is established in the seasons, in that there is the Evayāmarut hymn.

20.10.s: trivṛt ātirātreṇa brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta tejo vai trivṛt brahmavarcasaṃ teja eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe tejasi brahmavarcase pratitiṣṭhati pañcadaśenātirātreṇa vīryakāmo yajetaujo vīryaṃ pañcadaśa oja eva vīryam avarundha ojasi vīrye pratitiṣṭhati saptadaśenātirācreṇānnādyakāmo yajetānnaṃ vai saptadaśo 'nnādyam evāvarundha ekaviṃśenātirātreṇa pratiṣṭhākāmo yajeta pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśo yad atirātro bhavaty ahorātrayor eva pratitiṣṭhati
20.10.d: त्रिवृत् आतिरात्रेण ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो यजेत तेजो वै त्रिवृत् ब्रह्मवर्चसं तेज एव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् अवरुन्धे तेजसि ब्रह्मवर्चसे प्रतितिष्ठति पञ्चदशेनातिरात्रेण वीर्यकामो यजेतौजो वीर्यं पञ्चदश ओज एव वीर्यम् अवरुन्ध ओजसि वीर्ये प्रतितिष्ठति सप्तदशेनातिराच्रेणान्नाद्यकामो यजेतान्नं वै सप्तदशो ऽन्नाद्यम् एवावरुन्ध एकविंशेनातिरात्रेण प्रतिष्ठाकामो यजेत प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशो यद् अतिरात्रो भवत्य् अहोरात्रयोर् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
20.10.m: One who desires brahminical lustre should sacrifice with the ninefold stoma atirātra. Brilliance, indeed, is the ninefold stoma, brahminical lustre [is brilliance]; he wins brilliance, brahminical lustre; he is firmly established in brilliance and brahminical lustre. One who desires heroic strength should sacrifice with the fifteenfold stoma atirātra; vigour and heroic strength are the fifteenfold stoma; he wins vigour and heroic strength; he is firmly established in vigour and heroic strength. One who desires food should sacrifice with the seventeenfold stoma atirātra; food, indeed, is the seventeenfold stoma; he wins food. One who desires a firm footing should sacrifice with the twenty-one-fold stoma atirātra; a firm footing, indeed, is the twenty-one-fold stoma. Since it is an atirātra, he is firmly established in day and night.

20.11.d: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र उत्तरम्
20.11.m: The first day is the jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma; the subsequent day is the sarvastoma atirātra.

20.11.s: tasya caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ pañadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāna ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭhāni triṇava ārbhavas trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamam athaikaviṃśam atha saptadaśam ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
20.11.d: तस्य चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं पञदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमान एकविंशानि पृष्ठानि त्रिणव आर्भवस् त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमम् अथैकविंशम् अथ सप्तदशम् एकविंशः षोडशी पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
20.11.m: Of it, the bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-four-fold; the ājyastotras are fifteenfold; the mādhyandina pavamāna is seventeenfold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold; the ārbhava [pavamāna] is twenty-seven-fold; the agniṣṭoma is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas descend: the first is twenty-seven-fold, then twenty-one-fold, then seventeenfold; the ṣoḍaśin is twenty-one-fold; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is the ninefold stoma.

20.11.s: aṅgirasaḥ svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs teṣāṃ haviṣmāṃś ca haviṣkṛc cāṅgirasāv ahīyetā tāv āgacchetāṃ yato 'ṅgirasaḥ svargaṃ lokam āyaṃs tāv atapyetāṃ tāv ete sāmanī apaśyatāṃ tābhyāṃ dvirātram atanvātāṃ tena svargaṃ lokam aitām
20.11.d: अङ्गिरसः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् तेषां हविष्मांश् च हविष्कृच् चाङ्गिरसाव् अहीयेता ताव् आगच्छेतां यतो ऽङ्गिरसः स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् ताव् अतप्येतां ताव् एते सामनी अपश्यतां ताभ्यां द्विरात्रम् अतन्वातां तेन स्वर्गं लोकम् ऐताम्
20.11.m: The Aṅgirases were going to the heavenly world. Of them, Haviṣmat and Haviṣkṛt, two Aṅgirases, were left behind. They came to where the Aṅgirases had gone to the heavenly world. They performed ascetic heat; they saw these two sāmans. With them, they performed a two-day rite. By it they went to the heavenly world.

20.11.s: yaḥ pauṇyo hīna iva syāt sa etena yajetāpnoti pūrveṣāṃ prahām āpnutāṃ hi tāv aṅgirasaḥ
20.11.d: यः पौण्यो हीन इव स्यात् स एतेन यजेताप्नोति पूर्वेषां प्रहाम् आप्नुतां हि ताव् अङ्गिरसः
20.11.m: He who, having attained virtue, should seem left behind, should sacrifice with this [rite]. He attains the winning throw of the ancestors, for those two attained the Aṅgirases.

20.11.s: prajākāmo yajeta dvitīyaṃ hy etad yat prajāḥ
20.11.d: प्रजाकामो यजेत द्वितीयं ह्य् एतद् यत् प्रजाः
20.11.m: One desiring offspring should sacrifice [with it], for offspring are indeed a second [generation].

20.11.s: svargakāmo yajeta dvitīyād dhi lokāt paro loko 'bhiprakramyo durādho dvirātra ity āhur yad agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavaty ukthyam antaryanti yady ukthyo 'gniṣṭomam
20.11.d: स्वर्गकामो यजेत द्वितीयाद् धि लोकात् परो लोको ऽभिप्रक्रम्यो दुराधो द्विरात्र इत्य् आहुर् यद् अग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् उक्थ्यम् अन्तर्यन्ति यद्य् उक्थ्यो ऽग्निष्टोमम्
20.11.m: One desiring heaven should sacrifice [with it], for beyond the second world the higher world is to be stepped into. 'A two-day rite is difficult to obtain,' they say; 'if the first day is an agniṣṭoma, they omit the ukthya; if it is an ukthya, [they omit] the agniṣṭoma.'

20.11.s: yaj jyotir ukthyaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati nāgniṣṭomam antaryanti nokthāni
20.11.d: यज् ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति नाग्निष्टोमम् अन्तर्यन्ति नोक्थानि
20.11.m: When the first day is the jyotis ukthya, they neither omit the agniṣṭoma nor the ukthas.

20.11.s: tad āhur eṣā vāva yajñasya mātrā yad agniṣṭomo yad agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati yajñasya mātrāṃ nātikrāmaty athottarasyāhna ukthebhyo 'dhi rātrim upayanti tenokthāny anantaritāni
20.11.d: तद् आहुर् एषा वाव यज्ञस्य मात्रा यद् अग्निष्टोमो यद् अग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति यज्ञस्य मात्रां नातिक्रामत्य् अथोत्तरस्याह्न उक्थेभ्यो ऽधि रात्रिम् उपयन्ति तेनोक्थान्य् अनन्तरितानि
20.11.m: Regarding this they say: 'This indeed is the measure of sacrifice, namely the agniṣṭoma.' When the first day is an agniṣṭoma, he does not transgress the measure of sacrifice; and for the following day they approach the night beyond the ukthas; thereby the ukthas are not omitted.

20.11.s: caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavaty uttarasyāhnaś caturviṃśaty akṣarā gāyatrī prajananaṃ gāyatrī prajātyai
20.11.d: चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवत्य् उत्तरस्याह्नश् चतुर्विंशत्य् अक्षरा गायत्री प्रजननं गायत्री प्रजात्यै
20.11.m: The bahiṣpavamāna of the subsequent day is twenty-four-fold; twenty-four syllables has the gāyatrī; the gāyatrī is procreation, for procreation.

20.11.s: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
20.11.d: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
20.11.m: Both stomas, both the even and the odd [are used]; that is a pair; from that pair he is propagated.

20.11.s: sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam evaitenāpnoti sarvaṃ jayati
20.11.d: सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्य जित्यै सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्नोति सर्वं जयति
20.11.m: The atirātra has all the stomas, for the attainment of all, for the conquest of all. Through it he attains all; he conquers all.

20.12.s: atha yasya jyotir ukthyaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavaty āyur atirātra uttaram
20.12.d: अथ यस्य ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यः पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् आयुर् अतिरात्र उत्तरम्
20.12.m: Now, for whom the first day is the jyotis ukthya, the subsequent is the āyus atirātra.

20.12.s: tisraḥ pūrvasyāhno virājam atiricyante dvābhyām uttaram ahar virāja ūnam ūnātiriktaṃ vā anuprajāḥ prajāyante
20.12.d: तिस्रः पूर्वस्याह्नो विराजम् अतिरिच्यन्ते द्वाभ्याम् उत्तरम् अहर् विराज ऊनम् ऊनातिरिक्तं वा अनुप्रजाः प्रजायन्ते
20.12.m: Three [verses] of the first day exceed the virāj; by two the subsequent day is deficient of the virāj; out of the deficient and the redundant offspring are brought forth.

20.12.s: pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda
20.12.d: प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद
20.12.m: He propagates with offspring, with cattle, who knows thus.

20.12.s: ekā saṃstutānāṃ virājam atiricyate ekākinam evainam annādyasyādhyakṣaṃ karoti
20.12.d: एका संस्तुतानां विराजम् अतिरिच्यते एकाकिनम् एवैनम् अन्नाद्यस्याध्यक्षं करोति
20.12.m: One [verse] of the chanted ones exceeds the virāj; it makes him alone the overseer of food.

20.12.s: etena vai citrarathaṃ kāpeyā ayājayaṃs tam ekākinam annādyasyādhyakṣam akurvaṃs tasmāc caitrarathīnām ekaḥ kṣatrapatir jāyate 'nulamba iva dvitīyaḥ
20.12.d: एतेन वै चित्ररथं कापेया अयाजयंस् तम् एकाकिनम् अन्नाद्यस्याध्यक्षम् अकुर्वंस् तस्माच् चैत्ररथीनाम् एकः क्षत्रपतिर् जायते ऽनुलम्ब इव द्वितीयः
20.12.m: With this, indeed, the descendants of Kapi caused Citraratha to sacrifice. Him alone they made overseer of food. Therefore among the descendants of Citraratha one is born ruler of the realm, the second being, as it were, a follower.

20.13.s: atha yasya trivṛt pañcadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavaty āyur atirātra uttaram
20.13.d: अथ यस्य त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् आयुर् अतिरात्र उत्तरम्
20.13.m: Now, for whom the first day is the ninefold and fifteenfold agniṣṭoma, the subsequent is the āyus atirātra.

20.13.s: mithunābhyāṃ stomābhyām uttaram ahaḥ prajanayanti tat prajātaṃ śva ārabhante cakre vā ete sākaṃvṛtī yat trivṛt pañcadaśau stomau yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam etenābhyaśnute yatra yatra hi cakrīvatā kāmayate tat tad abhyaśnute
20.13.d: मिथुनाभ्यां स्तोमाभ्याम् उत्तरम् अहः प्रजनयन्ति तत् प्रजातं श्व आरभन्ते चक्रे वा एते साकंवृती यत् त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशौ स्तोमौ यं कामं कामयते तम् एतेनाभ्यश्नुते यत्र यत्र हि चक्रीवता कामयते तत् तद् अभ्यश्नुते
20.13.m: With two paired stomas they procreate the subsequent day; that which is procreated they undertake on the morrow. These, indeed, are two wheels turning together, namely the ninefold and fifteenfold stomas. Whatever desire he desires, that he reaches by it; for wherever one desires [to go] by means of a wheeled [chariot], to that he attains.

20.13.s: atha yad āyur atirātro bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
20.13.d: अथ यद् आयुर् अतिरात्रो भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
20.13.m: Now, that it is the āyus atirātra, is for firm standing.

20.13.s: etena vai kapivano bhauvāyana iṣṭvārūkṣatām agacchat
20.13.d: एतेन वै कपिवनो भौवायन इष्ट्वारूक्षताम् अगच्छत्
20.13.m: Having sacrificed with this, Kapivana Bhauvāyana attained sleekness.

20.13.s: arūkṣo bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān etena yajate
20.13.d: अरूक्षो भवति य एवं विद्वान् एतेन यजते
20.13.m: He becomes sleek, who, knowing thus, sacrifices with this.

20.14.s: trivṛt prātaḥsavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ saptadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ triṇavaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ trayastriṃśa ārbhavaś catustriṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśāny ukthāni saṣoḍaśikāni ṣoḍaśaṃ prathamaṃ rātriṣāma pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
20.14.d: त्रिवृत् प्रातःसवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनं पञ्चदशं प्रातःसवनं सप्तदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् एकविंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशं प्रातःसवनं त्रिणवं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रयस्त्रिंश आर्भवश् चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि सषोडशिकानि षोडशं प्रथमं रात्रिषाम पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
20.14.m: The morning pressing is ninefold, the midday pressing is fifteenfold, the third pressing is seventeenfold; [on the second day] the morning pressing is fifteenfold, the midday pressing is seventeenfold, the third pressing is twenty-one-fold with ukthas; [on the third day] the morning pressing is twenty-one-fold, the midday pressing is twenty-seven-fold, the ārbhava is thirty-three-fold, the agniṣṭoma is thirty-four-fold; the ukthas are twenty-one-fold with the ṣoḍaśin; the sixteenth is the first chant of the night; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

20.14.s: prajāpatir vā idam eka āsīt tasya vāg eva svam āsīd vāg dvitīyā sa aikṣatemām eva vācaṃ visṛjā iyaṃ vā idaṃ sarvaṃ vibhavanty eṣyatīti sa vācaṃ vyasṛjata sedaṃ sarvaṃ vibhavanty ait sordhvodātanod yathāpāṃ dhārā santataivaṃ tasyā eti tṛtīyam acchinat tad bhūmir abhavad abhūd iva vā idam iti tad bhūmer bhūmitvaṃ keti tṛtīyam acchinat tad antarikṣam abhavad antar eva vā idam iti tad antarikṣasyāntarikṣatvaṃ ho iti tṛtīyam ūrdhvam udāsyat tat dyaur abhavad adyutad iva vā iti tad divo divatvam
20.14.d: प्रजापतिर् वा इदम् एक आसीत् तस्य वाग् एव स्वम् आसीद् वाग् द्वितीया स ऐक्षतेमाम् एव वाचं विसृजा इयं वा इदं सर्वं विभवन्त्य् एष्यतीति स वाचं व्यसृजत सेदं सर्वं विभवन्त्य् ऐत् सोर्ध्वोदातनोद् यथापां धारा सन्ततैवं तस्या एति तृतीयम् अच्छिनत् तद् भूमिर् अभवद् अभूद् इव वा इदम् इति तद् भूमेर् भूमित्वं केति तृतीयम् अच्छिनत् तद् अन्तरिक्षम् अभवद् अन्तर् एव वा इदम् इति तद् अन्तरिक्षस्यान्तरिक्षत्वं हो इति तृतीयम् ऊर्ध्वम् उदास्यत् तत् द्यौर् अभवद् अद्युतद् इव वा इति तद् दिवो दिवत्वम्
20.14.m: Prajāpati was here alone. Speech was his own, speech was second [to him]. He considered: 'Let me emit this speech. She will go pervading all this.' He emitted speech. She went pervading all this. She extended upward like an uninterrupted stream of water. He cut off a third of her with 'e'; that became the earth, thinking 'it has become (abhūt), as it were, this [world]'; that is the earthliness of the earth. He cut off a third with 'ka'; that became the atmosphere, thinking 'it is inside (antar), as it were, this [world]'; that is the atmosphere's nature as atmosphere. He cast the third [part] upward with 'ho'; that became heaven, thinking 'it shone (adyutat), as it were'; that is heaven's nature as heaven.

20.14.s: eṣā vāva pratyakṣaṃ vāg yaj jihvāgreṇaitad vāco vadati yad eti madhyenaitad vāco vadati yat keti sarvayaitad vāco raso 'dhyūrdhva udvad ati yaddho iti
20.14.d: एषा वाव प्रत्यक्षं वाग् यज् जिह्वाग्रेणैतद् वाचो वदति यद् एति मध्येनैतद् वाचो वदति यत् केति सर्वयैतद् वाचो रसो ऽध्यूर्ध्व उद्वद् अति यद्धो इति
20.14.m: This indeed is speech manifested: when he speaks with the tip of the tongue, that of speech is 'e'; when he speaks with the middle of speech, that is 'ka'; when the essence of all speech sounds upward, that is 'ho'.

20.14.s: yad etāni rūpāṇy anvahaṃ vyajyante mukhata eva tad vācaṃ visṛjante mukhato yajñiyaṃ karma
20.14.d: यद् एतानि रूपाण्य् अन्वहं व्यज्यन्ते मुखत एव तद् वाचं विसृजन्ते मुखतो यज्ञियं कर्म
20.14.m: Since these forms are expressed day after day, they emit speech from the mouth; from the mouth [they emit] the sacrificial work.

20.14.s: prajāpatir vā idam ekākṣarāṃ vācaṃ satīṃ tredhā vyakarot ta ime lokā abhavan rūkṣā anupajīvanāḥ sa aikṣata katham ime lokā loma gṛhṇīyuḥ katham upajīvanīyāḥ syur iti sa etaṃ trirātram apaśyat tam āharat tenemān lokān anvātanot tato vā ime lokā lomāgṛhṇaṃs tata upajīvanīyā abhavaṃs trirātrasya vā idaṃ puṣṭaṃ trirātrasyodaraṇaṃ yad idam eṣu lokeṣv adhi
20.14.d: प्रजापतिर् वा इदम् एकाक्षरां वाचं सतीं त्रेधा व्यकरोत् त इमे लोका अभवन् रूक्षा अनुपजीवनाः स ऐक्षत कथम् इमे लोका लोम गृह्णीयुः कथम् उपजीवनीयाः स्युर् इति स एतं त्रिरात्रम् अपश्यत् तम् आहरत् तेनेमान् लोकान् अन्वातनोत् ततो वा इमे लोका लोमागृह्णंस् तत उपजीवनीया अभवंस् त्रिरात्रस्य वा इदं पुष्टं त्रिरात्रस्योदरणं यद् इदम् एषु लोकेष्व् अधि
20.14.m: Prajāpati, indeed, divided threefold speech which was [originally] of one syllable. These worlds became dry, not affording livelihood. He considered: 'How may these worlds take on hair? How may they become affording of livelihood?' He saw this three-day period. He grasped it; by it he extended these worlds. Thereupon these worlds took on hair; thereupon they became affording of livelihood. That is the nourishment of the three-day period, that is the rising of the three-day period, which is here upon these worlds.

20.14.s: gacchati paśūnāṃ bhūmānaṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ ya evaṃ veda
20.14.d: गच्छति पशूनां भूमानं द्विपदां चतुष्पदां य एवं वेद
20.14.m: He attains abundance of cattle, of two-footed and four-footed [beings], who knows thus.

20.14.s: prajāpatir yad vācaṃ vyasṛjata sākṣarad eveti prathamaṃ kṣeti dvitīyaṃ reti tṛtīyaṃ yena yena vai rūpeṇa prajāpatir vācaṃ vyasṛjata tena tena rūpeṇājyāni cārabhyante 'hāni cāpyante
20.14.d: प्रजापतिर् यद् वाचं व्यसृजत साक्षरद् एवेति प्रथमं क्षेति द्वितीयं रेति तृतीयं येन येन वै रूपेण प्रजापतिर् वाचं व्यसृजत तेन तेन रूपेणाज्यानि चारभ्यन्ते ऽहानि चाप्यन्ते
20.14.m: When Prajāpati emitted speech, it flowed (akṣarat): 'e' was the first, 'kṣa' the second, 'ra' the third. With whichever form Prajāpati emitted speech, with that form the ājyastotras are undertaken, and the days are reached.

20.14.s: tad āhur brahmavādino 'kṣarestho vai trirātra ity ekākṣarā vai vāk tryakṣaram akṣaraṃ tryakṣaraḥ puruṣaḥ sa vā enaṃ vedety āhur ya enaṃ puruṣasammitaṃ vedeti
20.14.d: तद् आहुर् ब्रह्मवादिनो ऽक्षरेस्थो वै त्रिरात्र इत्य् एकाक्षरा वै वाक् त्र्यक्षरम् अक्षरं त्र्यक्षरः पुरुषः स वा एनं वेदेत्य् आहुर् य एनं पुरुषसम्मितं वेदेति
20.14.m: Regarding this the theologians say: 'The three-day period is indeed based on the syllable. Speech consists of one syllable; the word akṣara consists of three syllables; man consists of three syllables. He indeed knows this,' they say, 'who knows it as commensurate with man.'

20.15.s: etena vai devā eṣu lokeṣv ārdhnuvann etena svargaṃ lokamāyan
20.15.d: एतेन वै देवा एषु लोकेष्व् आर्ध्नुवन्न् एतेन स्वर्गं लोकमायन्
20.15.m: By this indeed the gods prospered in these worlds; by this they went to the world of heaven.

20.15.s: vāg vai trirātro vāco rūpeṇājyāni cāhāni ca vibhajyanta ekākṣarā vai vāk tryakṣaram akṣaram akṣarasya rūpeṇa vibhajyante trayo gandharvās teṣām eṣā bhaktir agneḥ pṛthivī vāyor antarikṣam asāv ādityasya dyaus trayo gharmāsa uṣasaṃ sacante
20.15.d: वाग् वै त्रिरात्रो वाचो रूपेणाज्यानि चाहानि च विभज्यन्त एकाक्षरा वै वाक् त्र्यक्षरम् अक्षरम् अक्षरस्य रूपेण विभज्यन्ते त्रयो गन्धर्वास् तेषाम् एषा भक्तिर् अग्नेः पृथिवी वायोर् अन्तरिक्षम् असाव् आदित्यस्य द्यौस् त्रयो घर्मास उषसं सचन्ते
20.15.m: The three-day period is indeed speech; through the form of speech the ājyastotras and the days are distributed. Speech consists of one syllable; the word akṣara consists of three syllables; they are distributed through the form of the syllable. There are three Gandharvas; this is their portion: of Agni, the earth; of Vāyu, the atmosphere; of yonder Āditya, the sky. Three cauldrons accompany the Dawn.

20.15.s: agnir uṣasaṃ sacate vāyur uṣasaṃ sacate 'sāv āditya uṣasaṃ sacate
20.15.d: अग्निर् उषसं सचते वायुर् उषसं सचते ऽसाव् आदित्य उषसं सचते
20.15.m: Agni accompanies the Dawn; Vāyu accompanies the Dawn; yonder Āditya accompanies the Dawn.
There are three pairs; this is they.

20.15.s: mithunaṃ dve sambhavato mithunād yat prajāyate tat tṛtīyam
20.15.d: मिथुनं द्वे सम्भवतो मिथुनाद् यत् प्रजायते तत् तृतीयम्
20.15.m: Two unite as a pair; what is born from the pair, that is the third.

20.15.s: indro vṛtrāya vajram udayacchat so 'bravīn mā me praharṣīr asti vā idaṃ mayi vīryaṃ tat te pradāsyāmīti tad asmai prāyacchat tad viṣṇuḥ pratyagṛhṇāt sa dvitīyaṃ sa tṛtīyam udayacchat sa evābravīn mā me prahārṣīr asti vā idaṃ mayi vīryaṃ tat te pradāsyāmīti tad asmai prāyacchat tad viṣṇuḥ pratyagṛhṇād etad vāca tad abhyanūcyate
20.15.d: इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रम् उदयच्छत् सो ऽब्रवीन् मा मे प्रहर्षीर् अस्ति वा इदं मयि वीर्यं तत् ते प्रदास्यामीति तद् अस्मै प्रायच्छत् तद् विष्णुः प्रत्यगृह्णात् स द्वितीयं स तृतीयम् उदयच्छत् स एवाब्रवीन् मा मे प्रहार्षीर् अस्ति वा इदं मयि वीर्यं तत् ते प्रदास्यामीति तद् अस्मै प्रायच्छत् तद् विष्णुः प्रत्यगृह्णाद् एतद् वाच तद् अभ्यनूच्यते
20.15.m: Indra raised the thunderbolt against Vṛtra. He said: 'Do not strike me! There is indeed this virile power in me; I will give that to you.' He gave that to him; Viṣṇu received it. He raised [it] a second time, a third time. He indeed said: 'Do not strike me! There is indeed this virile power in me; I will give that to you.' He gave that to him; Viṣṇu received it. That is spoken of in this verse:

20.15.s: ubhau jigyathur na parājayethe na parājigye kataraś ca nainoḥ indraś ca viṣṇo yad apaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vitad airayethām iti
20.15.d: उभौ जिग्यथुर् न पराजयेथे न पराजिग्ये कतरश् च नैनोः इन्द्रश् च विष्णो यद् अपस्पृधेथां त्रेधा सहस्रं वितद् ऐरयेथाम् इति
20.15.m: 'You two have both conquered, you are not defeated; / neither of the two has been conquered, / when you, Indra and Viṣṇu, strove together, / you set into motion this thousand threefold.'

20.15.s: etad vā ābhyāṃ tat sahasraṃ prāyacchat
20.15.d: एतद् वा आभ्यां तत् सहस्रं प्रायच्छत्
20.15.m: He gave that thousand to these two.

20.15.s: tasyaiṣā bhaktir ya ārṣeyo vidvāṃs tasmai prathame 'hani deyaṃ yathā vā iyaṃ evaṃ sa pratiṣṭhiteyaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ saḥ
20.15.d: तस्यैषा भक्तिर् य आर्षेयो विद्वांस् तस्मै प्रथमे ऽहनि देयं यथा वा इयं एवं स प्रतिष्ठितेयं प्रतिष्ठितः सः
20.15.m: This is its distribution: to him who is of ṛṣi descent and learned, [a gift] is to be given on the first day. Just as this [earth] is firmly established, so is he firmly established.

20.15.s: yo 'nārṣeyo vidvāṃs tasmai dvitīye 'hani deyaṃ yathā vā antarikṣam evaṃ so 'ntarikṣam ity antarikṣaṃ vidur vedaṃ tasya viduḥ
20.15.d: यो ऽनार्षेयो विद्वांस् तस्मै द्वितीये ऽहनि देयं यथा वा अन्तरिक्षम् एवं सो ऽन्तरिक्षम् इत्य् अन्तरिक्षं विदुर् वेदं तस्य विदुः
20.15.m: To him who is not of ṛṣi descent, [yet] learned, [a gift] is to be given on the second day. Just as the atmosphere is, so is he; as the atmosphere is known, so his knowledge is known.

20.15.s: ya ārṣeyo vidvāṃs tasmai tṛtīye 'hani deyaṃ yathā vai dyaur evaṃ sa dyaur iti divaṃ vidur bandhu tasya viduḥ
20.15.d: य आर्षेयो विद्वांस् तस्मै तृतीये ऽहनि देयं यथा वै द्यौर् एवं स द्यौर् इति दिवं विदुर् बन्धु तस्य विदुः
20.15.m: To him who is of ṛṣi descent and learned, [a gift] is to be given on the third day. Just as the sky is, so is he; as the sky is known, so his kinship is known.

20.15.s: śatāny anvahaṃ dīyante eṣā vāva yajñasya mātrā yac chataṃ saiva sāvicchinnā dīyate daśato 'nvahaṃ dīyante daśākṣarā virāḍ vairājo yajñaḥ saiva sā vicchinnā dīyate
20.15.d: शतान्य् अन्वहं दीयन्ते एषा वाव यज्ञस्य मात्रा यच् छतं सैव साविच्छिन्ना दीयते दशतो ऽन्वहं दीयन्ते दशाक्षरा विराड् वैराजो यज्ञः सैव सा विच्छिन्ना दीयते
20.15.m: Hundreds are given day after day. This indeed is the measure of the sacrifice, namely a hundred; it is given continuous. Decads are given day after day. The virāj consists of ten syllables; the sacrifice belongs to the virāj; it is given continuous.

20.15.s: trayastriṃśac ca trīṇi ca śatāni prathame 'hani deyās tathā dvitīye tathā tṛtīye
20.15.d: त्रयस्त्रिंशच् च त्रीणि च शतानि प्रथमे ऽहनि देयास् तथा द्वितीये तथा तृतीये
20.15.m: Three hundred and thirty-three [cows] are to be given on the first day, likewise on the second, likewise on the third.

20.15.s: athaiṣā dvidevatyā trirūpā brahmaṇo dve tṛtīye tṛtīyam agnīdhaḥ
20.15.d: अथैषा द्विदेवत्या त्रिरूपा ब्रह्मणो द्वे तृतीये तृतीयम् अग्नीधः
20.15.m: Now this [cow] belonging to two deities has three forms: two thirds belong to the Brahman, the third to the Āgnīdhra.

20.15.s: kāmyāsi priyāsi havyāsīḍe rante sarasvati mahi viśruta etāni te 'ghnye nāmāni deveṣu naḥ sukṛto brūtāt
20.15.d: काम्यासि प्रियासि हव्यासीडे रन्ते सरस्वति महि विश्रुत एतानि ते ऽघ्न्ये नामानि देवेषु नः सुकृतो ब्रूतात्
20.15.m: 'Desirable are you, beloved are you, sacrificial are you, O Iḍā, Rantā, Sarasvatī, mighty, widely renowned; these are your names, O inviolable one; proclaim us as well-doers among the gods!'

20.16.s: idaṃ vāva prathamenāhnā vyakarod yad idam asyām adhyāyat ta mūlam idaṃ dvitīyena yad idaṃ prāṇād ejaty adas tṛtīyena yad varṣati yan nakṣatrāṇi yad amuṃ lokaṃ bheje
20.16.d: इदं वाव प्रथमेनाह्ना व्यकरोद् यद् इदम् अस्याम् अध्यायत् त मूलम् इदं द्वितीयेन यद् इदं प्राणाद् एजत्य् अदस् तृतीयेन यद् वर्षति यन् नक्षत्राणि यद् अमुं लोकं भेजे
20.16.m: With the first day he distinctly formed this, whatever has grown on this [earth] and its root; with the second day this, whatever breathes and moves; with the third day yonder, what rains, what are the constellations, and that he attained yonder world.

20.16.s: tad āhur brahmavādino mahāvrataṃ vā etad yad eṣa trirātra iti tasyai tad eva mukhaṃ yad eteṣām ahvāṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ ye abhito 'hanī tau pakṣau yan madhyamam ahaḥ sa ātmāgniṣṭomasāmāni puccham
20.16.d: तद् आहुर् ब्रह्मवादिनो महाव्रतं वा एतद् यद् एष त्रिरात्र इति तस्यै तद् एव मुखं यद् एतेषाम् अह्वां बहिष्पवमानं ये अभितो ऽहनी तौ पक्षौ यन् मध्यमम् अहः स आत्माग्निष्टोमसामानि पुच्छम्
20.16.m: Regarding this the theologians say: 'This three-day period is indeed the Mahāvrata.' Its head is just the Bahiṣpavamāna of these days; the two days on both sides are the two wings; the middle day is the trunk; the Agniṣṭoma-sāmans are the tail.

20.16.s: yad evāsāv udeti tan mukhaṃ ye abhito 'hanī tau pakṣau yan madhyamam ahaḥ sa ātmāgniḥ puccham
20.16.d: यद् एवासाव् उदेति तन् मुखं ये अभितो ऽहनी तौ पक्षौ यन् मध्यमम् अहः स आत्माग्निः पुच्छम्
20.16.m: When yonder [sun] rises, that is its head; the two days on both sides are the two wings; the middle day is the trunk; Agni is the tail.

20.16.s: yad evāsāv udeti tan mukhaṃ ye abhito 'hanī tau pakṣau yan madhyamam ahaḥ sa ātmā yad astam eti tat puccham
20.16.d: यद् एवासाव् उदेति तन् मुखं ये अभितो ऽहनी तौ पक्षौ यन् मध्यमम् अहः स आत्मा यद् अस्तम् एति तत् पुच्छम्
20.16.m: When yonder [sun] rises, that is its head; the two days on both sides are the two wings; the middle day is the trunk; when it sets, that is the tail.

20.16.s: etāvān vāva trirātro gāyatraḥ prāṇas traiṣṭubhaṃ cakṣur jāgataṃ śrotraṃ sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda
20.16.d: एतावान् वाव त्रिरात्रो गायत्रः प्राणस् त्रैष्टुभं चक्षुर् जागतं श्रोत्रं सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद
20.16.m: So great indeed is the three-day period: out of the gāyatrī is the out-breath, out of the triṣṭubh the eye, out of the jagatī the ear. He attains a full lifespan who knows thus.

20.16.s: tad āhur brahmavādinaḥ kiyāṃs trirātra itīyān iti brūyād iyaddhayetad abhy atho iyān iti brūyād iyaddhayevaitad abhiparā3ṅ arvā3ṅ ity āhuḥ parāṅ iti brūyāt parāṅ hi vadati parāṅ paśyati parāṅ prāṇity ekā3 dvā3 u trayā3 ity āhur eka iti brūyāt samāno hy eṣa yat prāṇo 'pāno vyānas tad yathā vā ado maṇau sūtram otam evam eṣu lokeṣu trirātra otaḥ śobhate 'sya mukhaṃ ya evaṃ veda
20.16.d: तद् आहुर् ब्रह्मवादिनः कियांस् त्रिरात्र इतीयान् इति ब्रूयाद् इयद्धयेतद् अभ्य् अथो इयान् इति ब्रूयाद् इयद्धयेवैतद् अभिपरा3ङ् अर्वा3ङ् इत्य् आहुः पराङ् इति ब्रूयात् पराङ् हि वदति पराङ् पश्यति पराङ् प्राणित्य् एका3 द्वा3 उ त्रया3 इत्य् आहुर् एक इति ब्रूयात् समानो ह्य् एष यत् प्राणो ऽपानो व्यानस् तद् यथा वा अदो मणौ सूत्रम् ओतम् एवम् एषु लोकेषु त्रिरात्र ओतः शोभते ऽस्य मुखं य एवं वेद
20.16.m: Regarding this the theologians say: 'How great is the three-day period?' One should say: 'So great,' for it extends over so much. Then one should say: 'So great,' for it extends over just so much. 'Is it directed away or directed hither?' they ask. One should say: 'Directed away,' for he speaks facing away, he sees facing away, he breathes facing away. 'Is it one, or two, or three?' they ask. One should say: 'One,' for it is uniform, just as out-breath, in-breath, and diffused breath [are one]. Just as a thread is strung through a jewel, so the three-day period is strung through these worlds. His face shines who knows thus.

20.16.s: yad vai trirātrasya saloma tad asya viloma yad asya viloma tad asya saloma tad yad etat paraṃ sad ahar avaraṃ kriyate yajamānāyaiva tat paśūn parigṛhṇāti prajananāya na hy amuṣmin loke paśavaḥ prajāyante
20.16.d: यद् वै त्रिरात्रस्य सलोम तद् अस्य विलोम यद् अस्य विलोम तद् अस्य सलोम तद् यद् एतत् परं सद् अहर् अवरं क्रियते यजमानायैव तत् पशून् परिगृह्णाति प्रजननाय न ह्य् अमुष्मिन् लोके पशवः प्रजायन्ते
20.16.m: What is with the hair of the three-day period, that is against its hair; what is against its hair, that is with its hair. When that day which is higher is made lower, it grasps cattle for the sacrificer for propagation; for in yonder world cattle are not propagated.

20.16.s: ete vāva chandasāṃ vīryavattame yad gāyatrī ca triṣṭup ca yad ete abhito bhavato madhye jagatī vīryavatībhyām eva tac chandobhyāṃ paśūn parigṛhṇāti prajananāya na hy amuṣmin loke paśavaḥ prajāyante
20.16.d: एते वाव छन्दसां वीर्यवत्तमे यद् गायत्री च त्रिष्टुप् च यद् एते अभितो भवतो मध्ये जगती वीर्यवतीभ्याम् एव तच् छन्दोभ्यां पशून् परिगृह्णाति प्रजननाय न ह्य् अमुष्मिन् लोके पशवः प्रजायन्ते
20.16.m: These two are indeed the most vigorous of the metres: the gāyatrī and the triṣṭubh. When these two are on both sides and the jagatī in the middle, it is through the two vigorous metres that he grasps cattle for propagation; for in yonder world cattle are not propagated.

20.16.s: asau vāva trirātro yathodety evaṃ prathamam ahar yathā madhyandina evaṃ dvitīyaṃ yathāstam ety evaṃ tṛtīyaṃ gacchaty amuṣyasāyujyaṃ gacchati sāveśyaṃ ya evaṃ veda
20.16.d: असौ वाव त्रिरात्रो यथोदेत्य् एवं प्रथमम् अहर् यथा मध्यन्दिन एवं द्वितीयं यथास्तम् एत्य् एवं तृतीयं गच्छत्य् अमुष्यसायुज्यं गच्छति सावेश्यं य एवं वेद
20.16.m: The three-day period is indeed yonder [sun]: as it rises, such is the first day; as it is at midday, such is the second; as it sets, such is the third. He attains union with yonder [sun], he attains cohabitation [with him], who knows thus.

21.1.s: indro marutaḥ sahasram ajināt svāṃ viśaṃ somāya rājñe procya tasmād rājñe procya viṃśa jinanti tau yamo 'śṛṇon maruto ha sahasram ajyāśiṣṭām iti sa āgacchat so 'bravīd upa māsmin sahasre hvayethām iti tam upāhvayetāṃ sa yamo 'paśyad ekāṅgāṃ sahasre 'pi sahasrasya payo bibhratīṃ so 'bravīd iyam eva mamāstu sahasraṃ yuvāṃ vikalpayethām iti tāv abrūtāṃ yathā vāva tvam etāṃ paśyasy evam āvam etāṃ paśyāva iti
21.1.d: इन्द्रो मरुतः सहस्रम् अजिनात् स्वां विशं सोमाय राज्ञे प्रोच्य तस्माद् राज्ञे प्रोच्य विंश जिनन्ति तौ यमो ऽशृणोन् मरुतो ह सहस्रम् अज्याशिष्टाम् इति स आगच्छत् सो ऽब्रवीद् उप मास्मिन् सहस्रे ह्वयेथाम् इति तम् उपाह्वयेतां स यमो ऽपश्यद् एकाङ्गां सहस्रे ऽपि सहस्रस्य पयो बिभ्रतीं सो ऽब्रवीद् इयम् एव ममास्तु सहस्रं युवां विकल्पयेथाम् इति ताव् अब्रूतां यथा वाव त्वम् एतां पश्यस्य् एवम् आवम् एतां पश्याव इति
21.1.m: Indra deprived the Maruts, his own clan, of a thousand [cows], after announcing [it] to King Soma. Therefore, after announcing [it] to the king, they deprive the clan [of their property]. Yama heard of those two: 'They have deprived the Maruts of a thousand.' He came and said: 'Invite me also to this thousand.' They invited him. That Yama saw [a cow] of single limb within the thousand, bearing the milk of the thousand. He said: 'Let this one be mine; you two divide the thousand.' Those two said: 'Just as you see this one, so we two see this one.'

21.1.s: tayā vā idaṃ sahasraṃ vikalpayāmahā ity abruvaṃs tām udake prāveśayaṃs te 'bravan na śānāharāmahai yasmai na iyaṃ prathamāyādeṣyati iti te 'ṃśān āharanta somasya prathama aid athendrasyātha yamasya
21.1.d: तया वा इदं सहस्रं विकल्पयामहा इत्य् अब्रुवंस् ताम् उदके प्रावेशयंस् ते ऽब्रवन् न शानाहरामहै यस्मै न इयं प्रथमायादेष्यति इति ते ऽंशान् आहरन्त सोमस्य प्रथम ऐद् अथेन्द्रस्याथ यमस्य
21.1.m: They said: 'By means of her let us divide this thousand.' They made her enter into the water. They said: 'Let us cast lots as to who among us she will approach first.' They cast lots; Soma's [lot] came out first, then Indra's, then Yama's.

21.1.s: te 'bruvan somāya rājña udehi tṛtīyena cātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasa iti sā babhruḥ piṅgākṣy ekavarṣodait tṛtīyena cātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasaḥ sā yā somakrayaṇī saiva sā
21.1.d: ते ऽब्रुवन् सोमाय राज्ञ उदेहि तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयस इति सा बभ्रुः पिङ्गाक्ष्य् एकवर्षोदैत् तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयसः सा या सोमक्रयणी सैव सा
21.1.m: They said: 'Rise up for King Soma with a third of your body and a third of the milk of the thousand!' She, brown, yellow-eyed, one year old, rose up with a third of her body and a third of the milk of the thousand. She who is the cow for purchasing the Soma is that very one.

21.1.s: tṛtīyena cāsya tasyā ātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasaḥ somaḥ krīto bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān somaṃ krīṇāti yasmā evaṃ viduṣe somaṃ krīṇanti
21.1.d: तृतीयेन चास्य तस्या आत्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयसः सोमः क्रीतो भवति य एवं विद्वान् सोमं क्रीणाति यस्मा एवं विदुषे सोमं क्रीणन्ति
21.1.m: And with a third of her body and a third of the milk of the thousand his Soma is purchased, who, knowing thus, purchases Soma, [or] for whom, knowing thus, they purchase Soma.

21.1.s: te 'bruvann indrāyodehi tṛtīyena cātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasa iti sā śabalī paṣṭhauhy udait tṛtīyena cātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasaḥ sā yendriyaiṣyā saiva sā
21.1.d: ते ऽब्रुवन्न् इन्द्रायोदेहि तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयस इति सा शबली पष्ठौह्य् उदैत् तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयसः सा येन्द्रियैष्या सैव सा
21.1.m: They said: 'Arise for Indra with a third of yourself and with a third of the milk of the thousand!' She arose as a dappled, six-year-old cow with a third of herself and with a third of the milk of the thousand. She is this [cow] desired for power; she is indeed that one.

21.1.s: tṛtīyena cāsya tasyā ātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasa indriyaiṣyā dattā bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān indriyaiṣyāṃ dadāti yasmā evaṃ viduṣa indriyaiṣyāṃ dadāti
21.1.d: तृतीयेन चास्य तस्या आत्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयस इन्द्रियैष्या दत्ता भवति य एवं विद्वान् इन्द्रियैष्यां ददाति यस्मा एवं विदुष इन्द्रियैष्यां ददाति
21.1.m: With a third of her own self and with a third of the milk of the thousand, the [cow] desired for power has been given for him who, knowing thus, gives the [cow] desired for power, and for him to whom, knowing thus, they give the [cow] desired for power.

21.1.s: te 'bruvan yamāyodehi tṛtīyena cātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasa iti sā jaratī kuṣṭhāśṛṅgyad aid dhūmrā vā dityauhīrmato hrasīyasī tṛtīyena cātmanaḥ tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payasaḥ sā yānustaraṇī saiva sā
21.1.d: ते ऽब्रुवन् यमायोदेहि तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयस इति सा जरती कुष्ठाशृङ्ग्यद् ऐद् धूम्रा वा दित्यौहीर्मतो ह्रसीयसी तृतीयेन चात्मनः तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयसः सा यानुस्तरणी सैव सा
21.1.m: They said: 'Arise for Yama with a third of yourself and with a third of the milk of the thousand!' She arose as an old cow, lame and hornless, or smoke-coloured, a two-year-old heifer, shorter than a dwarf, with a third of herself and with a third of the milk of the thousand. She who is the anustaraṇī cow, she is indeed that one.

21.1.s: tṛtīyena cāsya tasyā ātmanas tṛtīyena ca sahasrasya payaso 'nustaraṇī kṛtā bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān anustaraṇīṃ karoti yasmā evaṃ viduṣe 'nustaraṇīṃ kurvanti nācakṛvān manyate
21.1.d: तृतीयेन चास्य तस्या आत्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य पयसो ऽनुस्तरणी कृता भवति य एवं विद्वान् अनुस्तरणीं करोति यस्मा एवं विदुषे ऽनुस्तरणीं कुर्वन्ति नाचकृवान् मन्यते
21.1.m: With a third of her own self and with a third of the milk of the thousand, the anustaraṇī cow has been prepared for him who, knowing thus, prepares the anustaraṇī cow, and for him for whom, knowing thus, they prepare the anustaraṇī cow. He does not consider himself to have failed.

21.1.s: tad āhur brahmavādino na vā amuṣmin loke sahasrayāḍ aloko 'stīti tad yāvad itaḥ sahasrasya gaur gavi pratiṣṭhitā tāvad asmāl lokād asau lokaḥ sarasrayājī vā imān lokān vyāpnoty atho yāvat sahasraṃ yojanāny atho sahasram āśvīnān yatho yāvat sahasram ahnayāni tad gavā gavā spṛṇoti samākramaṇāya vā etā dīyante
21.1.d: तद् आहुर् ब्रह्मवादिनो न वा अमुष्मिन् लोके सहस्रयाड् अलोको ऽस्तीति तद् यावद् इतः सहस्रस्य गौर् गवि प्रतिष्ठिता तावद् अस्माल् लोकाद् असौ लोकः सरस्रयाजी वा इमान् लोकान् व्याप्नोत्य् अथो यावत् सहस्रं योजनान्य् अथो सहस्रम् आश्वीनान् यथो यावत् सहस्रम् अह्नयानि तद् गवा गवा स्पृणोति समाक्रमणाय वा एता दीयन्ते
21.1.m: Regarding this, the expounders of sacred lore say: 'In that world, indeed, one who has sacrificed with a thousand does not lack a world.' For as far as a cow of the thousand, standing upon a cow, extends from here, so far is that world from this world. One who sacrifices with a thousand indeed pervades these worlds, even as far as a thousand leagues, or a thousand horse-days' journeys, or as far as a thousand day-marches. He wins it through cow after cow; for these are given for stepping across.

21.1.s: sahasraṃ yad asṛjata tasya tārpyaṃ yonir āsīd yat tārpyaṃ pratyasya nayati sayonitvāya
21.1.d: सहस्रं यद् असृजत तस्य तार्प्यं योनिर् आसीद् यत् तार्प्यं प्रत्यस्य नयति सयोनित्वाय
21.1.m: When he created the thousand, the woven cloth was its womb. In that he brings forth the woven cloth, casting it down, [he does so] for possessing its proper womb.

21.2.s: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā asmāt sṛṣṭāḥ parācya āyan natsyati na iti bibhyatyaḥ so 'bravīd upa mā vartadhvaṃ tathā vai vo 'tsyāmi yathādyamānā bhūyasyaḥ prajaniṣyatha iti tābhyo vainaṃ ṛtaṃ brūhīty abruvaṃs tābhya ṛtanidhanenartam abravīd īnidhanenāvayat triṇidhanena prājanayad etair ha vā idaṃ sāmabhir mṛtyuḥ prajā atti ca prajanayati
21.2.d: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत ता अस्मात् सृष्टाः पराच्य आयन् नत्स्यति न इति बिभ्यत्यः सो ऽब्रवीद् उप मा वर्तध्वं तथा वै वो ऽत्स्यामि यथाद्यमाना भूयस्यः प्रजनिष्यथ इति ताभ्यो वैनं ऋतं ब्रूहीत्य् अब्रुवंस् ताभ्य ऋतनिधनेनर्तम् अब्रवीद् ईनिधनेनावयत् त्रिणिधनेन प्राजनयद् एतैर् ह वा इदं सामभिर् मृत्युः प्रजा अत्ति च प्रजनयति
21.2.m: Prajāpati created creatures. Once created from him, they moved away, fearing: 'He will eat us!' He said: 'Turn towards me! I will eat you only in such a way that, while being eaten, you will be born forth more abundantly.' They said to him: 'Speak the cosmic order to us.' To them he spoke the cosmic order with the ṛta-cadence, he made them grow with the ī-cadence, [and] he caused them to be born forth with the tri-cadence. By these sāmans indeed Death eats creatures and causes them to be born forth.

21.2.s: adyamānasya bhūyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
21.2.d: अद्यमानस्य भूयो भवति य एवं वेद
21.2.m: There is an increase of what is being eaten for one who knows thus.
These are indeed the elder-sāmans, the best-sāmans, the sāmans of Prajāpati.

21.2.s: gacchati jyaiṣṭhayaṃ śraiṣṭhayaṃ ya evaṃ veda
21.2.d: गच्छति ज्यैष्ठयं श्रैष्ठयं य एवं वेद
21.2.m: He who knows thus attains seniority and pre-eminence.

21.2.s: etair vai sāmabhiḥ prajāpatir imān lokān sarvān kāmān dugdhe yad ācyā dugdhe tad ācyā dohānām ācyā dohatvam
21.2.d: एतैर् वै सामभिः प्रजापतिर् इमान् लोकान् सर्वान् कामान् दुग्धे यद् आच्या दुग्धे तद् आच्या दोहानाम् आच्या दोहत्वम्
21.2.m: By these sāmans Prajāpati indeed milks all desires from these worlds. Because he milks them by stretching, that is the stretch-milking nature of the stretch-milkings.

21.2.s: sarvān imān lokān kāmān dugdhe ya evaṃ vidvān etais sāmabhiḥ stute
21.2.d: सर्वान् इमान् लोकान् कामान् दुग्धे य एवं विद्वान् एतैस् सामभिः स्तुते
21.2.m: He milks all desires from these worlds who, knowing thus, chants with these sāmans.

21.2.s: ime vai lokā etāni sāmāny ayam evartanidhanam antarikṣam īnidhanaṃ dyaus triṇidhanam
21.2.d: इमे वै लोका एतानि सामान्य् अयम् एवर्तनिधनम् अन्तरिक्षम् ईनिधनं द्यौस् त्रिणिधनम्
21.2.m: These worlds are indeed these sāmans: this [earth] is the ṛta-cadence, the intermediate space is the ī-cadence, the sky is the tri-cadence.

21.2.s: yathā kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetrāṇy anusañcaraty evam imān lokān anusañcarati ya evaṃ veda
21.2.d: यथा क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्राण्य् अनुसञ्चरत्य् एवम् इमान् लोकान् अनुसञ्चरति य एवं वेद
21.2.m: Just as one who knows the fields traverses the fields, so he traverses these worlds who knows thus.

21.2.s: agner vā etāni vaiśvānarasya sāmāni yatra vā etair aśāntaiḥ stuvanti tat prajā devo ghātuko bhavaty agnim upanidhāya stuvate svāyā eva tad devatāyāḥ sāmyekṣāya namaskṛtyodgāyati śāntais stuvanti
21.2.d: अग्नेर् वा एतानि वैश्वानरस्य सामानि यत्र वा एतैर् अशान्तैः स्तुवन्ति तत् प्रजा देवो घातुको भवत्य् अग्निम् उपनिधाय स्तुवते स्वाया एव तद् देवतायाः साम्येक्षाय नमस्कृत्योद्गायति शान्तैस् स्तुवन्ति
21.2.m: These are indeed the sāmans of Agni Vaiśvānara. Where they chant with these when not pacified, there the god becomes destructive to creatures. Having placed a fire near, they chant; having paid homage to his own deity for direct perception, the udgātṛ sings. They chant with [sāmans] that are pacified.

21.3.s: vāg vai śabalī tasyās trirātro vatsas trirātro vā etāṃ pradāpayati
21.3.d: वाग् वै शबली तस्यास् त्रिरात्रो वत्सस् त्रिरात्रो वा एतां प्रदापयति
21.3.m: Speech is indeed the dappled cow (Śabalī); her calf is the three-day rite. The three-day rite indeed causes her to give milk.

21.3.s: tad ya evaṃ veda tasmā eṣā prattā dugdhe
21.3.d: तद् य एवं वेद तस्मा एषा प्रत्ता दुग्धे
21.3.m: Therefore, she, being given, yields milk for him who knows thus.

21.3.d: यो ऽलम् अन्नाद्याय सन्न् अथान्नं नाद्यात्
21.3.m: One who, being capable of [enjoying] food, yet should not eat food,

21.3.s: barāsīṃ paridhāya taptaṃ piban dvādaśa rātrīr adhaḥ śayīta
21.3.d: बरासीं परिधाय तप्तं पिबन् द्वादश रात्रीर् अधः शयीत
21.3.m: having put on a coarse hemp garment, drinking hot [water], should lie on the ground for twelve nights.

21.3.s: yā dvādaśī syāt tasyā upavyuṣaṃ śabalīhomaṃ hutvā purā vāgbhyaḥ sampravaditor yatra grāmyasya paśor nāśṛṇuyāt tad araṇyaṃ paretya darbhastambam ālabhya śabali śabalīti trir āhvayed yad anyac chunaś ca gardabhāc ca prativāśyate sā samṛddhā
21.3.d: या द्वादशी स्यात् तस्या उपव्युषं शबलीहोमं हुत्वा पुरा वाग्भ्यः सम्प्रवदितोर् यत्र ग्राम्यस्य पशोर् नाशृणुयात् तद् अरण्यं परेत्य दर्भस्तम्बम् आलभ्य शबलि शबलीति त्रिर् आह्वयेद् यद् अन्यच् छुनश् च गर्दभाच् च प्रतिवाश्यते सा समृद्धा
21.3.m: On whichever is the twelfth, at dawn, having offered the Śabalī-oblation before voices sound forth, having gone out to the wilderness where he would not hear [the sound of] a domestic animal, taking hold of a clump of darbha grass, he should call out thrice: 'O Śabalī! O Śabalī!' If anything other than a dog or a donkey answers with a cry, it has succeeded.

21.3.s: yadi na prativāśyeta saṃvatsare punar āhvayeta
21.3.d: यदि न प्रतिवाश्येत संवत्सरे पुनर् आह्वयेत
21.3.m: If no answer should be made with a cry, he should call out again after a year.

21.3.s: śabali samudro 'si viśvavyacā brahma devānāṃ prathamajā ṛtasyānnam asi śukram asi tejo 'sy amṛtam asi tāṃ tvā vidma śabali dīdyānāṃ tasyāste pṛthivī pādo 'ntarikṣaṃ pādo dyauḥ pādaḥ samudraḥ pāda eṣāsi śabali tāṃ tvā vidma sā na iṣam ūrjaṃ dhukṣva vasordhārāṃ śabali prajānāṃ śaciṣṭhā vratam anugeṣaṃ svāhā
21.3.d: शबलि समुद्रो ऽसि विश्वव्यचा ब्रह्म देवानां प्रथमजा ऋतस्यान्नम् असि शुक्रम् असि तेजो ऽस्य् अमृतम् असि तां त्वा विद्म शबलि दीद्यानां तस्यास्ते पृथिवी पादो ऽन्तरिक्षं पादो द्यौः पादः समुद्रः पाद एषासि शबलि तां त्वा विद्म सा न इषम् ऊर्जं धुक्ष्व वसोर्धारां शबलि प्रजानां शचिष्ठा व्रतम् अनुगेषं स्वाहा
21.3.m: 'O Śabalī, you are the ocean, all-encompassing, sacred lore, first-born of the gods, of cosmic order! You are food, you are seed, you are brilliance, you are immortality! As such, shining brightly, we know you, O Śabalī. Of you, the earth is a foot, the intermediate space is a foot, the sky is a foot, the ocean is a foot. Such are you, O Śabalī; as such we know you. As such, milk for us nourishment and vigour, a stream of wealth, O Śabalī, most mighty of creatures! May I follow the observance. Svāhā!'

21.4.d: चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंश उक्थ्यः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः
21.4.m: The agniṣṭoma has the fourfold stoma, the ukthya has the twenty-one-fold stoma, the atirātra has all the stomas.

21.4.s: prajāpater vā akṣy aśvat tat parāpatat tad aśvo 'bhavat tad aśvasyāśvatvaṃ tad devā aśvamedhena pratyadadhur eṣa vāva prajāpatiṃ sarvaṃ karoti yo 'śvamedhena yajate
21.4.d: प्रजापतेर् वा अक्ष्य् अश्वत् तत् परापतत् तद् अश्वो ऽभवत् तद् अश्वस्याश्वत्वं तद् देवा अश्वमेधेन प्रत्यदधुर् एष वाव प्रजापतिं सर्वं करोति यो ऽश्वमेधेन यजते
21.4.m: Prajāpati's eye swelled; it fell away. It became a horse; that is the horse-nature of the horse. The gods restored it by means of the horse sacrifice. He indeed makes Prajāpati whole who sacrifices with the horse sacrifice.

21.4.s: eṣa vāva saśarīraḥ sambhavaty amuṣmai lokāyayo 'śvamedhī
21.4.d: एष वाव सशरीरः सम्भवत्य् अमुष्मै लोकाययो ऽश्वमेधी
21.4.m: He indeed comes into being with a body for that world who performs the horse sacrifice.

21.4.s: saraghā vā aśvasya sakthy āvṛhat tad devāś catuṣṭomena pratyadadhur yac catuṣṭomo bhavaty aśvasya sarvatvāya
21.4.d: सरघा वा अश्वस्य सक्थ्य् आवृहत् तद् देवाश् चतुष्टोमेन प्रत्यदधुर् यच् चतुष्टोमो भवत्य् अश्वस्य सर्वत्वाय
21.4.m: A bee tore out the horse's thigh. The gods restored it by means of the fourfold stoma. In that there is the fourfold stoma, it is for the completeness of the horse.

21.4.s: yat tisro 'nuṣṭubhaś catasro gāyatrīḥ karoti tasmāt tribhis tiṣṭhan pratitiṣṭhati sarvān palāyamānaḥ pratidadhāti
21.4.d: यत् तिस्रो ऽनुष्टुभश् चतस्रो गायत्रीः करोति तस्मात् त्रिभिस् तिष्ठन् प्रतितिष्ठति सर्वान् पलायमानः प्रतिदधाति
21.4.m: In that he makes three anuṣṭubhs and four gāyatrīs, therefore, standing on three [legs], it stands firmly; running, it sets down all [four].

21.4.s: anto vā aśvaḥ paśūnām anto 'nuṣṭup chandasām anto viṣṇur devatānām antaś catuṣṭomas stomānām antas trirātro yajñānāṃ yad vaiplavyo 'nuṣṭubhaḥ pratipado bhavanti catuṣṭoma stomas trirātro yajño 'nta eva tadantaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati
21.4.d: अन्तो वा अश्वः पशूनाम् अन्तो ऽनुष्टुप् छन्दसाम् अन्तो विष्णुर् देवतानाम् अन्तश् चतुष्टोमस् स्तोमानाम् अन्तस् त्रिरात्रो यज्ञानां यद् वैप्लव्यो ऽनुष्टुभः प्रतिपदो भवन्ति चतुष्टोम स्तोमस् त्रिरात्रो यज्ञो ऽन्त एव तदन्तं प्रतिष्ठापयति
21.4.m: The horse is the end of cattle, the anuṣṭubh is the end of metres, Viṣṇu is the end of deities, the fourfold stoma is the end of stomas, the three-day rite is the end of sacrifices. In that floating anuṣṭubhs are the introductory verses, the fourfold stoma is the stoma, and the three-day rite is the sacrifice, he thereby establishes the end upon the end.

21.4.s: ekaviṃśam ahar bhavati yasminn aśva ālabhyata ekaviṃśo vā ito 'sāv ādityo dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśa ādityasyaivainaṃ mātrāṃ gamayati
